title: DJ Wars
overview: DJ Wars is a rhythm game which simulates the experience of performing as a club DJ. The player is given control of two turntables, a mixing desk, and a variety of effects and scratches, and must select a sequence of tracks and mix between them to get the crowd dancing and excited. The main story mode lets the player choose from one of five DJs, each with their own signature tracks and preferred music styles, and must perform at each of the nine clubs in the city. Skilled performance and track selections that match the clientele's tastes will reward the player with higher marks, and the ultimate goal is to play at the biggest club in the city. There is also a studio mode where the player can practice their mixing skills, and can also sample custom tracks from other CDs to mix with in addition to the included tracks in the game.
